test_title: SSC Stenographer 2025 Official Paper (Held On: 07 Aug, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: A train 150 m long passes a pole in 10 seconds. What is its speed in km/h?
solution:
**Given:**

Length of the train (L) = 150 m

Time taken to pass the pole (T) = 10 s

**Formula used:**

Speed = (Distance)/(Time)

Note: When a train passes a pole, the distance covered is equal to the length of the train.

To convert m/s to km/h, multiply by &
